senses.gloss: m. (סוּם I, v. סוּמָא II) mark, sign; omen; symptom; cipher, mnemotechnical note.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 22b:11">B. Mets. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ העשוי לידרס לא הוי ס׳</he> a mark (on a lost object) which is liable to be effaced by treading upon it, is no mark (by which one can claim it).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 23a:6">Ib. 23ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ הבא מאליו</he> an accidental mark (not made purposely).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 24b:2">Ib. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>נתן בה ס׳</he> he told a sign (by which he identified it).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 27b:18">Ib. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ מובהק</he> a distinguished (specific) mark of identification.—
<cite ref="Taanit 30b:3">Taan. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>אינו רואה סִימַן ברכה וכ׳</he> will never see a sign of blessing (will labor without success).—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 16b:18">Kidd. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>דברי הכל ס׳</he> all agree that it is a sign of puberty.
<cite ref="Chullin 61a:2">Ḥull. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>עוף הבא בס׳ אחד</he> a bird which has one of the four marks of cleanness.

Erub. 54ᵇ (ref. to שימה, Deut. XXXI, 19) א״ת שימה אלא סִימָנָהּ read not simah (put it), but simanah (its mark, catchwords). Ib. 54ᵃ, a. fr. (editorial gloss) ס׳ וכ׳ the catchwords for the subject following are &c.; a. v. fr.—Trnsf. the organ, the cutting of which is an indication that the animal has been slaughtered according to the ritual, the windpipe and the gullet.

<cite ref="Chullin 27b:7">Ḥull. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>הכשרו בס׳ אחד</he> is made ritually fit for eating by the cutting of either of the organs; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="O00709"><he>סִימָנִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00709"><he>סִימָנִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 27a:24">B. Mets. 27ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ס׳ דאורייתא וכ׳</he> is identification by marks a Biblical or a rabbinical institution? <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:5">Ib. II, 5</cite> <he>שיש בה ס׳</he> which can be identified by signs.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:7">Ib. 7</cite> <he>אמר אבידה ולא אמר סִימָנֶיהָ</he> if he states the object he has lost, but cannot describe it.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 4a:20">Kidd. 4ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>סִימָנֵי נערות</he> evidences of puberty (v. <cite ref="N01010"><he>נַעֲרוּת</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 16a:14">Ib. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>קונה את עצמה בס׳</he> acquires herself (becomes free) on showing evidences of puberty.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 16b:18">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>אין ס׳ באיש</he> a man-servant does not go out free on reaching puberty. Ḥull.III, 6 <he>סימני בהמה וכ׳</he> the distinguishing marks of cleanness in animals &c. Ib. 27ᵇ <he>לחייבו בשני ס׳</he> to make it obligatory to cut both organs (the windpipe and the gullet). Ib. 44ᵃ <he>עיקור ס׳</he> the case of the organs’ being torn loose before cutting.
<cite ref="Eruvin 54b:23">Erub. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>אין התורה … בס׳</he> knowledge of the Law can be obtained only by means of signs (rubrication by catchwords).
<cite ref="Eruvin 21b">Ib. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>סימני טעמים</he> notes of accentuation (v. <cite ref="I00611"><he>טַעַם</he></cite>); a. fr.
